# cubepath_availability_groups (Data Source)

Fetches the list of availability groups for a CubePath Cloud project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) The ID of the project to list availability groups for.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) List of availability groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the availability group was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the availability group.
- `location_name` (String) The location where the availability group operates.
- `max_servers` (Number) Maximum number of VPS in this group.
- `name` (String) The name of the availability group.
- `strategy` (String) The placement strategy (spread or cluster).
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the availability group.
- `vps_count` (Number) Current number of VPS in this group.
